Its back is two hard, closed, polished wing cases of old gold meeting in a straight seam down the middle, with a darker bronze-brown plate between them and the head. Gripped between its two front legs, touching the front of its head, it carries one small round ball of bright sunlight, about the size of its own head, as scarabs are shown in Egyptian carvings.
